title: Conveyancing Legal Secretary
company: A1 Personnel Employment Agency Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Conveyancing Legal Secretary - Leigh on Sea

Exciting Legal Career Opportunity Leigh on Sea Competitive Salary

Are you an experienced Legal Secretary with a background in Conveyancing? Looking for your next opportunity within a busy and professional legal environment?

This could be the perfect role for you!

The Role
- Provide secretarial and administrative support to a Conveyancing Solicitor
- Assist with residential property transactions from instruction through to completion
- Prepare and format legal correspondence and documentation
- Communicate professionally with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other parties
- Manage appointments, deadlines and key dates
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date client files and records
- Carry out general administrative and conveyancing support duties
- Assist with searches, enquiries and other aspects of the conveyancing process

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary within Conveyancing
- Good understanding of the residential conveyancing process
- Strong IT and administrative skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Ability to manage deadlines and prioritise a busy workload
- Professional and client-focused approach
- A proactive attitude and willingness to support the wider team

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary
- Leigh on Sea, Essex
- Opportunity to develop your legal and conveyancing knowledge
- Excellent career development potential
- Supportive and professional working environment
- Varied and interesting conveyancing work

Ready for Your Next Move?

If you're an organised and motivated Conveyancing Legal Secretary looking for a new opportunity in Romford, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply today with your CV to find out more.

title: Conveyancing Legal Secretary
company: JS Legal Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Conveyancing Legal Secretary

JS Legal Recruitment are excited to be working with one of the largest Law Firms in Essex. Due to continued growth my client is actively recruiting for an experienced Residential Conveyancing Legal Secretary to join their busy property department.

Our client is committed to providing excellent customer service, if you re an experienced Residential Conveyancing Legal Secretary / Legal Assistant our client would like to hear from you.

The Role
- To provide secretarial support to the property fee earner
- Screening incoming calls
- Dealing with new business opportunities so that these are processed efficiently helping to ensure the continued success of the property department
- Audio typing using digital dictation
- Diary management , booking rooms and arranging meetings
- Using case management system
- Liaise with clients, solicitors, Estate agents and mortgage lenders
- Providing quotations , sending out client care letters
- Deal with client queries, and take instruction from clients
- Amend and reformat documents
- Apply for searches using on line services including land registry
- Using HRMC website to complete stamp duty land tax forms
- Deal with post completion matters
- Maintain client files, opening and closing of files
- Maintain the filing system
- Assist fee earners in the maintenance of client accounts

Experience required:
- Recent Residential or Commercial Property experience essential
- Fast and accurate audio typing skills, including Digital dictation
- Experience with Microsoft office , word, outlook, Excel
- Able to prioritise and multitask
- Excellent telephone manor
- Possess the ability to deal with client queries when fee earners are out of the office
- Friendly working environment
- Competitive salary
- Office based Monday to Friday 9am- 5.30pm however part time will also be considered

Apply Now.

If you feel this is the right opportunity for you, Contact Julie Sheridan at JS Legal Recruitment Ltd, quoting reference JSL2312 OR email now your cv or call for a confidential discussion .

For more information on other vacancies JS Legal recruitment Ltd are handling please visit our website.

All successful applications will be responded to within 7 working days. If you have not been contacted within this timescale your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

title: Legal Secretary -Private Client
company: A1 Personnel Employment Agency Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Legal Secretary

Location: Maldon, Essex

Dept: Private Client

Salary: Up to £30,000 per annum (depending on experience)

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised and professional Legal Secretary to join our clients established Private Client team in Witham. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced secretary who enjoys working in a fast-paced legal environment, providing comprehensive administrative support to fee earners while delivering an exceptional level of client service.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the department by managing documentation, coordinating diaries, liaising with clients and supporting colleagues across the office.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide dedicated secretarial and administrative support to fee earners.
- Produce legal correspondence, reports and documents using audio dictation and word processing software.
- Manage client files, including opening, maintaining, archiving and retrieving files in accordance with firm procedures.
- Prepare outgoing post and ensure all supporting documentation is enclosed and dispatched promptly.
- Arrange photocopying, scanning and document preparation as required.
- Coordinate appointments, meetings and maintain accurate electronic and manual diaries.
- Organise meeting rooms, ensuring they are prepared in advance and cleared after use.
- Welcome clients and visitors in a professional and friendly manner, both in person and over the telephone.
- Assist with general office administration and provide support to colleagues when required.
- Offer assistance and guidance to junior members of the administrative team where appropriate.
- Provide reception cover during busy periods or staff absence.
- Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality in relation to client information and firm documentation.
- Participate in training and development opportunities to enhance skills and knowledge.

Skills & ExperienceEssential
- Previous experience in a legal secretarial or professional administrative role.
- Excellent audio typing and document production skills with a high level of accuracy.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook and Excel.
- Outstanding organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a varied workload.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work efficiently under pressure while maintaining attention to detail.
- Professional, discreet and committed to maintaining confidentiality.
- A proactive and flexible approach with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

Desirable
- Previous experience within a law firm.
- Familiarity with legal case management systems.
- Secretarial or business administration qualification.

Personal Qualities

The ideal candidate will be:
- Professional, courteous and client-focused.
- Well organised with excellent time management skills.
- Calm and composed when working to deadlines.
- Reliable, adaptable and able to use their own initiative.
- A strong team player who is happy to support colleagues across the business.
- Positive, approachable and committed to delivering high standards of work.

Working Environment

This is an office-based position within a busy and friendly legal practice. The role offers a varied workload, working closely with experienced fee earners and support staff to ensure clients receive an efficient and professional service at every stage of their matter.

Performance Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:
- Accuracy and quality of document production.
- Effective diary and file management.
- Positive client feedback and service standards.
- Timely completion of administrative tasks.
- Reliability and contribution to the wider team.
- Compliance with firm procedures and confidentiality requirements.

title: Paralegal
description:
Paralegal
Location: Colchester
Salary: £26,226
Job Type: Permanent
Hybrid: 3 days office / 2 days home

We are working with a highly regarded UK law firm to recruit a Paralegal into its specialist Property Securitisation team in Colchester.

The Role

Working closely with Partners and Solicitors, responsibilities will include:
- Undertaking title checks and property due diligence
- Obtaining Land Registry documents and conducting searches
- Assisting with pre and post-completion matters
- Managing your own caseload and monitoring outstanding items
- Providing progress updates to clients and fee earners
- Supporting the team on large-scale transactions

About You
- Minimum 2:1 degree in Law, Politics, Economics or a Humanities-related subject
- Previous property or conveyancing experience is advantageous
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Strong communication, research and drafting abilities
- Confident managing competing priorities and deadlines
- Proactive, professional and keen to develop within a specialist legal team

Please apply today if you are interested.
